# uzc_vm_snapshots (Data Source)

Lists UzCloud virtual machine snapshots (global list, not scoped to one VM).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "uzc_vm_snapshots" "all" {}

output "vm_snapshot_slugs" {
  value = [for s in data.uzc_vm_snapshots.all.snapshots : s.slug]
}
```
